_comment: Macify engine registry. Engines provide the dock and/or menu bar. Native is built in; others are third-party integrations (see docs/ENGINES.md).

engines.name: Macify Native
engines.description: Built-in PowerShell + WPF bar, dock, Spotlight and Control Center. No downloads, no admin.

engines.name: MyDockFinder
engines.description: Popular third-party macOS dock + menu bar for Windows (closed-source, official builds via Steam/mydockfinder.com). Macify detects your install, manages auto-start, and keeps native Spotlight as a complement.
